name: chilli-beans-ecommerce
description: E-commerce premium para CHILLI BEANS — óculos de sol e grau

scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const src = fs.existsSync('dist/index.dev.html') ? 'dist/index.dev.html' : 'dist/index.html'; fs.copyFileSync(src, 'index.html'); fs.copyFileSync(src, 'dist/index.html'); fs.mkdirSync('docs', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(src, 'docs/index.html');"
